title: Find the titles of well-finished posts that have a view count above the ave
question: Find the titles of well-finished posts that have a view count above the average and are associated with users who earned a 'Student' badge in either 2010 or 2011. Among these, return only those posts that received more than 4 votes.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_035
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
JOIN (
    SELECT v.XCL_067, COUNT(*) AS vote_count
    FROM votes v
    GROUP BY v.XCL_067
) vc ON p.XCL_026 = vc.XCL_067
WHERE p.XCL_044 IS NOT NULL
  AND p.XCL_030 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_030) FROM posts)
  AND b.XCL_003 = 'Student'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2010' OR STRFTIME('%Y', b.XCL_004) = '2011')
  AND vc.vote_count > 4
